reviewer_statement: Developer-reviewed scientific source-semantic parity for the Python 1.2 mathematical result and return schema. Existing source comparisons plus new typed Python 1.2 whole-field/provenance tests for five contrast scales or both mixed covariance types with two inference scopes, invalid-domain tests and non-square arrays. Exact-head CI runs have not completed, and no independent external certification is claimed.
native_language_semantic_policy: Published source scientific numeric and provenance contract represented with native R scientific lists/matrices/arrays. Python frozen dataclass identity, exception classes, and arbitrary Python object introspection are not native R types.

case_evidence.description: Frozen Python typed FunctionalMixedEffectsBootstrapResult or FunctionalMixedEffectsFullRefitBootstrapResult and native R explicit bootstrap_type scientific equivalents.

Retained finite bootstrap coefficient arrays and bootstrap mean/standard error observed-grid matrices for both conditional-covariance and full-refit source subclasses; coefficient versus family scope.

Whole-participant bootstrap-centered maximum absolute studentized deviations, NumPy higher quantile, coefficient/family critical values, observed-grid estimate-centered lower/upper bands and retained pointwise standard errors.

Unknown typed bootstrap kind, malformed B-by-coefficient-by-time dimensions, zero/nonfinite bootstrap standard errors, invalid scope and invalid confidence are rejected; source exception class identity unavailable in R.
All source band names, reference and bootstrap nesting, non-square matrix and max-statistic shapes, source per-coefficient/family selected domain and complete variance-refit provenance.

Participant cluster bootstrap observed-grid simultaneous coefficient inference; bootstrap distribution centered on bootstrap mean, final limits centered on reference estimate, no continuous between-grid coverage claim.

independent_review_status: Author-reviewed, source-pinned evidence only; exact-head CI and independent review outstanding.
language_specific_limits: R scientific records are analogous to Python typed dataclass results but cannot satisfy Python isinstance/identity semantics.
Source-produced finite observed-grid scientific arrays and errors are compared, rather than accepting arbitrary unvalidated Python objects.
Author-reported scientific parity is separate from exact-head CI, independent certification and release qualification.
